user_text:
I am changing the acceptance criteria. Agents do not need to play through or beat each level or the campaign. Use focused automated checks for mechanics, loading, transitions, saves, retry and cleanup, plus brief visual inspections.
Do not require a full route, defeating every enemy or reaching the exit before accepting a level and starting the next. Record any untested full-playthrough behavior and continue development autonomously.
This instruction supersedes earlier requirements for agent-completed playthroughs. Update the durable development and acceptance records accordingly.
scope: Acceptance/validation changes only; full8Act3 levelcontent/mechanical boundaries, sequentialownership, sharedqueue and desktopendpoint remain.
